evidence.citation: “Inspect the live checkout and identify every file the runner created or modified… Remove only runner-created files and revert only runner-authored edits… Verify the checkout contains no remaining leaks or runner side effects… Start a new run with a fresh, context-free agent.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The inspection, selective cleanup, leak verification, and clean rerun are necessary controls for preserving unrelated work and restoring isolation, provenance, integrity, and valid blind evaluation. The artifact requires no materially unnecessary execution work.
